title: RightBrainReview
description: Semantic and contextual review produced by the RIGHT brain before consensus.

intent_id.description: Must match the intent this review is for.

decision.description: APPROVE = plan is semantically aligned. REVISE = plan needs adjustment. BLOCK = plan violates boundary. HOLD = needs human before proceeding.

semantic_summary.description: Plain-language explanation of what the plan actually does vs what was requested.

scope_status.description: Whether the plan stays within the stated request boundary.

boundary_status.description: Whether ConsMAP / project boundaries (corpus, BOPHAMETH, draft status) are respected.

claim_hygiene.description: ConsMAP claim hygiene assessment. Optional but recommended.

human_confirmation.description: Whether human must explicitly confirm before Sentinel may proceed.

must_not_touch.description: Paths or assets RIGHT identifies as protected in this context.
